text: Teaching Objectives To learn the basic theory and knowledge in the field of accounting, auditing and business administration and get trained in the basic skills in accounting and auditing. Expected to have reasonable strong ability to analyze and solve problems in accounting and auditing field. Major Courses Management Accounting and Auditing Financial Management Money and Banking (Provincial Quality Courses) Management Science Micro-economics Macro-economics Information Management System Financial Accounting Cost Accounting Internship They will be qualified upon graduation for auditing jobs in certified accountant offices both at home and abroad. Degree Awarded Bachelor’s Degree in Management Future Career In commercial enterprises as accountant and financial affairs executive.
